notes: CBCUS01C on GENERATED inputs (#3804): the input file is built from the CVCUS01Y record layout (edge values first, unique keys in key order) instead of CardDemo's data file, proving the carddemo-readcust port on records it was not written against. CBCUS01C reads the customer master and DISPLAYs each record; its FD declares the record inline (two items), so the layout is the copybook it reads INTO.
